name: Reverse Mountain
description: The mountain where four ocean currents ascend to form the entry point into the Grand Line.

name: Cactus Island (Whisky Peak)
description: An island surrounded by cactus-shaped rocks that are actually gravestones of bounty hunters.

name: Little Garden
description: A primordial jungle inhabited by giant dinosaurs and dueling giant warriors Dorry and Brogy. Log Pose takes 1 full year to record magnetic memory!

name: Drum Island (Sakura Kingdom)
description: A snow-covered medical kingdom ruled by the Lapans and Drum Rockies. Birthplace of Tony Tony Chopper.

name: Alabasta Kingdom
description: Vast desert realm governed by the Nefertari Royal Family, threatened by Warlord Crocodile's Baroque Works.

name: Jaya Island
description: Lawless pirate haven of Mock Town and former home of Mont Blanc Noland, split by the Knock-Up Stream.

name: Skypiea (Sky Island)
description: Legendary island floating 10,000 meters in the sky above Jaya, featuring Upper Yard and God Enel's Shrine.

name: Long Ring Long Land
description: An archipelago of ten ring-shaped islands connected during annual low tides. Home to elongated animals.

name: Water 7
description: The metropolis of shipwrights built on water. Home of Galley-La Company, Franky Family, and birthplace of Thousand Sunny.

name: Enies Lobby
description: The judicial island of the World Government hanging above a bottomless ocean waterfall.

name: Thriller Bark
description: The world's largest pirate ship masquerading as an island, controlled by Warlord Gecko Moria.

name: Sabaody Archipelago
description: A massive forest of Yarukiman Mangroves producing natural resin bubbles, gateway to the New World.

name: Marineford
description: Former Headquarters of the Marines, site of the historic Paramount War between Whitebeard Pirates and the Marines.

name: Fish-Man Island
description: Submerged paradise located in a giant bubble 10,000 meters beneath Sabaody at the base of Red Line.

name: Punk Hazard
description: Quarantined World Government research facility divided into burning magma and frozen tundra by Akainu and Aokiji.

name: Dressrosa Kingdom
description: The country of love, passion, living toys, and Corrida Colosseum, formerly ruled by Donquixote Doflamingo.

name: Zou (Zunesha)
description: A phantom island located on the back of Zunesha, a 1000-year-old colossal elephant wandering the New World.

name: Whole Cake Island (Totto Land)
description: The heart of Emperor Big Mom's archipelago domain made entirely of edible sweets, pastries, and Homies.

name: Wano Country
description: Isolationist land of samurai perched atop massive waterfalls, liberated from Emperor Kaido by Sun God Nika.

name: Egghead Island
description: The Future Island containing Dr. Vegapunk's laboratory, Pacifistas, punk records, and ancient energy secrets.

name: Laugh Tale (Raftel)
description: The ultimate destination at the end of the Grand Line where Gol D. Roger left the One Piece treasure. Reachable only via four Road Poneglyphs!
